title: Change the e-mail address of a person
rule: An event payload holds IDs, not copies of personal data (docs/conventions/events.md, ADR-0011)
source: anifit-platform AN-135 and AN-146 (personal data plain in the bridge log and in the outbox) and #137 (names reached the log backend, found after the merge). `pnpm pii` was green each time: it checks the metadata of columns, not what an event carries.
prompt:
A person can change the e-mail address.

- Add `changeEmail(personId, email)` to the public API of the identity module. It stores the new address the same way `registerPerson` does (trimmed, lower case) and returns the person.
- It fails for an unknown person. It fails with `EmailAlreadyRegisteredError` when another person has the address.
- Other modules must learn about each change of an e-mail address.
- `createApp()` in `apps/worker` must expose it as `app.identity.changeEmail`.

When you are done, the change must be ready for a pull request.
